description: Backlog of feature, UI, and monetization ideas for Carbon, a stateful API replica/emulation tool. Organized by theme, each item includes an implementation note pointing at where it would live in the existing monorepo.

core_runtime_and_state.description: Compare two snapshots (or a snapshot against a live replica) resource-by-resource, showing added/removed/changed fields.
core_runtime_and_state.implementation_note: New endpoint in apps/api/src/routes/snapshots.ts (e.g. GET /v1/snapshots/:slug/diff?a=&b=); diff logic can live in packages/state alongside StateSnapshot.

core_runtime_and_state.feature: Drift detection against the real API
core_runtime_and_state.description: Periodically replay recorded traffic against the real upstream API and flag when responses no longer match the behavior graph, so mocks don't silently go stale.
core_runtime_and_state.implementation_note: New scheduled job in apps/workers/src/index.ts; reuse packages/proxy for the real-API calls.

core_runtime_and_state.description: Step backward and forward through state mutations within a single replica session, not just save/restore whole snapshots.
core_runtime_and_state.implementation_note: Extend packages/state/src/engine.ts to log a mutation journal; UI in dashboard 'state' section.

core_runtime_and_state.description: Let users define starting fixtures per resource (e.g. 'always start with 3 users') instead of an empty state.
core_runtime_and_state.implementation_note: Extend carbon.config.ts schema; wire into packages/state/src/snapshot.ts as an initial snapshot.

core_runtime_and_state.description: Toggle between strict relational consistency and 'anything goes' loose mode for teams testing error-handling paths.
core_runtime_and_state.implementation_note: packages/graph/src/traversal.ts; expose as a runtime option in packages/runtime/src/runtime.ts.

chaos_and_testing.description: One-click presets like 'flaky network,' 'slow third-party,' '3rd-party outage' that bundle latency + error-injection rules.
chaos_and_testing.implementation_note: Build on packages/runtime/src/plugins/error-injection.ts and latency.ts; store presets in packages/database/src/schema.ts.

chaos_and_testing.description: Validate that the real API's responses still match the ingested OpenAPI/protobuf schema, catching upstream breaking changes automatically in CI.
chaos_and_testing.implementation_note: New package packages/contract-test or extend packages/parser adapters with a validate() pass.

chaos_and_testing.description: Fire N concurrent synthetic requests at a running emulator and report latency percentiles, using the same harness as benchmarks/scripts/throughput.ts.
chaos_and_testing.implementation_note: Expose benchmarks/scripts/throughput.ts logic as an API action button in the emulators dashboard section.

chaos_and_testing.description: Let users assert 'this endpoint must always return under 200ms' or 'this field must never be null' and surface violations in the activity feed.
chaos_and_testing.implementation_note: New rules engine in packages/runtime/src/plugins/; violations recorded via the events table.

dashboard_ui_and_buttons.description: Multi-step modal: paste a spec URL or upload a file -> pick format -> confirm inferred resources (using packages/ai capabilities) -> create.

dashboard_ui_and_buttons.feature: 'Start emulator' / 'Stop emulator' buttons with live status pill
dashboard_ui_and_buttons.description: Inline actions on the projects and emulators list, polling apps/api/src/routes/emulators.ts action routes.
dashboard_ui_and_buttons.implementation_note: apps/dashboard/app/[section]/page.tsx (emulators section) once wired per the hardening prompt Phase 1.

dashboard_ui_and_buttons.feature: 'Copy curl' / 'Copy SDK snippet' button per endpoint
dashboard_ui_and_buttons.description: On an endpoint detail view, one click copies a ready-to-run curl command or packages/sdk usage snippet.
dashboard_ui_and_buttons.implementation_note: apps/dashboard graphs/endpoint detail view; generate from the IR already produced by packages/parser.

dashboard_ui_and_buttons.description: Re-run packages/ai inferResources/inferRelationships on an existing project after docs change, with a diff preview before applying.
dashboard_ui_and_buttons.implementation_note: apps/api/src/routes/ingest.ts new action; packages/ai/src/capabilities.ts already has the logic.

dashboard_ui_and_buttons.description: Quick-jump to any project, snapshot, or emulator, plus quick actions (new project, save snapshot).
dashboard_ui_and_buttons.implementation_note: apps/dashboard, likely using packages/ui components; index built from the same api-client added in the hardening prompt.

dashboard_ui_and_buttons.feature: Dark/light theme toggle persistence per user
dashboard_ui_and_buttons.description: theme-toggle.tsx already exists in both apps/web and apps/dashboard; persist preference to the user's account instead of just local state.
Visual checkbox editor for read/write/admin scopes when creating a key, instead of raw scope strings.
dashboard_ui_and_buttons.implementation_note: apps/dashboard 'keys' section; apps/api/src/routes/api-keys.ts already supports scoped keys.

dashboard_ui_and_buttons.description: 'No snapshots yet' should link straight to 'save your first snapshot' inline instead of just prose.
dashboard_ui_and_buttons.implementation_note: apps/dashboard/lib/empty-data.ts descriptions -> actionable buttons per section.

collaboration_and_team.description: Snapshots become collaborative artifacts: tag them, comment on them, mark one as the CI baseline.
collaboration_and_team.implementation_note: Extend the artifacts table in packages/database/src/schema.ts with tags/comments; UI in dashboard 'snapshots'.

collaboration_and_team.feature: Org member roles surfaced in UI
collaboration_and_team.description: Settings page showing owner/admin/member roles with invite/remove, using the memberships table that already exists.
collaboration_and_team.implementation_note: New apps/api/src/routes/organizations.ts per hardening prompt Phase 4; UI in apps/dashboard 'settings'.

collaboration_and_team.description: Restrict a project to specific org members, not just org-wide access.
collaboration_and_team.implementation_note: Extend project-access resolution in apps/api/src/routes/project-access.ts with a project_members join table.

collaboration_and_team.description: Notify a channel when a snapshot is overwritten, an emulator crashes, or drift is detected.
collaboration_and_team.implementation_note: apps/workers webhook handler (apps/workers/src/handlers/webhook.ts already exists as a pattern to extend).

developer_experience.description: Run carbon emulate, browse the behavior graph, and inspect resource state without leaving the editor.
Auto-spin a per-PR replica from the committed spec, comment with a shareable inspect link, tear down on PR close.
developer_experience.implementation_note: New apps/github-action package using packages/sdk's carbon.emulate().

developer_experience.description: One-click 'Open in Carbon' from a Postman collection, going straight through the existing postman.ts adapter.
developer_experience.implementation_note: packages/parser/src/adapters/postman.ts already parses this; add a dashboard import shortcut.

developer_experience.description: Diagnose common local setup issues (port conflicts, missing env vars, stale node_modules) in one command.
developer_experience.implementation_note: apps/cli/src/commands/, following the pattern of apps/cli/src/commands/init.ts.

developer_experience.description: Visual node-graph of resources and their relationships (owns/belongs-to/references), clickable to jump to endpoints.
developer_experience.implementation_note: apps/dashboard 'graphs' section; data already exists in packages/graph/src/builder.ts output.

monetization_and_enterprise.description: Checkout, customer portal, and webhook-driven subscription state, gating Team/Enterprise features server-side.
monetization_and_enterprise.implementation_note: New apps/api/src/routes/billing.ts and a subscriptions table, per hardening prompt Phase 4.

monetization_and_enterprise.description: Metered emulator-minutes or ingest volume as an upsell beyond flat seat pricing.
monetization_and_enterprise.implementation_note: apps/api/src/services/emulator-registry.ts and ingest.ts already track the raw usage signals needed.

monetization_and_enterprise.description: Enterprise-tier login and automated user provisioning/deprovisioning.
monetization_and_enterprise.implementation_note: Better Auth SSO plugin (if auth is consolidated per hardening prompt Phase 2) + new apps/api/src/routes/scim.ts.

monetization_and_enterprise.description: Compliance-friendly export of the events table for security review.
monetization_and_enterprise.implementation_note: GET /v1/events/export in apps/api/src/routes/events.ts, built on the events table from hardening prompt Phase 3.

monetization_and_enterprise.description: Org-level setting for how long snapshots/events are kept, with an automated purge job.
monetization_and_enterprise.implementation_note: New column on organizations table + scheduled job in apps/workers/src/index.ts.

monetization_and_enterprise.description: Package docker-compose.yml into a documented, tested self-host path for Enterprise customers who won't use Neon/Upstash.
monetization_and_enterprise.implementation_note: Root docker-compose.yml already exists; add docker-compose.selfhost.yml + DEPLOY.md section.

monetization_and_enterprise.feature: White-label / custom domain for hosted replicas
monetization_and_enterprise.description: Let Enterprise customers serve emulators under their own subdomain for internal demo environments.
monetization_and_enterprise.implementation_note: apps/api emulator registry + reverse proxy config; likely needs a wildcard DNS + TLS story.

ai_and_automation.description: 'Make POST /orders fail 10% of the time with a 503' typed in plain English, translated into an error-injection rule via packages/ai.
ai_and_automation.implementation_note: New capability in packages/ai/src/capabilities.ts alongside inferResources/inferRelationships.

ai_and_automation.description: Auto-populate a fresh replica with plausible fake data matching the inferred resource schemas, instead of starting empty.
ai_and_automation.implementation_note: packages/ai new capability + packages/state seeding hook.

ai_and_automation.description: AI drafts integration test skeletons against the replica based on the ingested spec, so teams get test coverage 'for free' after import.
ai_and_automation.implementation_note: New apps/cli command, e.g. carbon generate-tests, using packages/ai + packages/sdk.

ai_and_automation.feature: Anomaly summarization in the activity feed
ai_and_automation.description: AI summarizes a burst of events ('12 failed emulator starts in the last hour, likely a port conflict') instead of a raw log.
ai_and_automation.implementation_note: Batch job reading the events table, using packages/ai providers.

growth_and_distribution.description: Curated one-click 'try Carbon against the Stripe/GitHub/Shopify API' demos on the marketing site to lower the activation barrier.
growth_and_distribution.implementation_note: apps/web new /gallery route; each entry is a pre-ingested benchmarks/fixtures-style spec.

growth_and_distribution.description: Send a teammate or prospect a link to poke at a running replica without giving them CLI/API access.
growth_and_distribution.implementation_note: apps/api emulator registry + a scoped, read-only, time-limited token.

growth_and_distribution.description: A markdown/HTML badge API authors can drop in their README, like a 'Deploy to Vercel' button, that spins a live replica of their own spec.
growth_and_distribution.implementation_note: apps/web new embed route + packages/sdk emulate() call behind it.

growth_and_distribution.feature: Benchmarks page kept live, not static
growth_and_distribution.description: apps/web has a /benchmarks methodology page and benchmarks/results/latest.json — wire the page to render the latest JSON automatically on each release instead of manual copy.
growth_and_distribution.implementation_note: apps/web/app (benchmarks route) reading benchmarks/results/latest.json at build time.
